name: link-page-builder
description: Make your own “link in bio” page in minutes: your name, a short bio, a round photo and a stack of link buttons, in one of six themes. Everything is in a single index.html — no scripts, no trackers, no external files — so you can upload it to any host or share it from your own domain, plus a QR code that points to it. Edit links in a table, highlight the important one, hide old ones. Runs locally; no account on a link-page service or API keys.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 几分钟做好自己的“个人链接主页”：名字、一句简介、圆形头像和一列链接按钮，有六种主题可选。所有内容都在一个 index.html 里——没有脚本、没有追踪、不引用外部文件——可以上传到任何空间或放在自己的域名下，还会生成指向主页的二维码。在表格里编辑链接，重要的可以突出显示，旧的可以隐藏。在本地运行，不用注册链接主页服务，无需 API 密钥。
